semiconductor_relevance: High — DIC Chemitronics specializes in advanced materials that enhance semiconductor manufacturing processes and device performance.
summary: DIC Chemitronics develops unique materials that integrate chemistry and electronics, focusing on applications in semiconductors, communications, and batteries. Their innovative solutions, such as DAITAC® Process Stretch Tape and eFLOW®/SEPAREL®, address critical challenges in manufacturing, including bonding, interface control, and yield enhancement.
capabilities: DAITAC® Process Stretch Tape for quick peeling without heat or UV
eFLOW® ultra-pure water solution for resistivity control
SEPAREL® bubble removal for uniform coating
